# `@videojs/spf/features/error`

Source: [src/playback/features/error.ts](../../../src/playback/features/error.ts)

## errorFeature

Collects the errors the other features report into `state.errors`, per source. Without it, reporting is a no-op.

### Behaviors

1. [collectErrors](../behaviors/collect-errors.md#collecterrors)

Carries no severity: which of these is fatal is decided above the engine, at the adapter. See `internal/design/spf/features/errors.md`. |
| `presentation` | `MaybeResolvedPresentation \| undefined` | — | [collectErrors](../behaviors/collect-errors.md#collecterrors) | The presentation being played.
